observations: body L3: the sign «>» after «solstitialium.» closes the words opened by «<» at the foot of p. 204, which note 1 says are quoted also by al-Marghītī.
body L3-L5: the dashes of «al–Ǵādirī» and «al–Battānī» are long dashes (5.3 to 5.5 pt); the letter-spaced name of al-Battānī is divided between L3 and L4 with a hyphen (2.8 pt).
body L9-L11, L32: the dashes of «214–215», «1799–1802», «165–166» and «369–372» are long dashes (4.8 to 5.3 pt).

body L20-L23: in Letronne's words 1° in 80 years would be 45″ a year; the 40″ he names are 1° in 90 years, and the Sun passes them in 16m 14s at its mean daily motion of 59′ 8″ (printed 16m 19s). Hipparchus' year, 365 days 5 hours 55m, with 16m added gives the 365 days 6 hours 11m of the edition of Bologna.
body L25, L29-L30: the dashes of «disent–ils», «Th.–H.» and «a–t–elle» are long dashes (5.3 to 5.4 pt).

notes_left L1-L13: the dashes of the transliterated names and of the years «1896-97», «1391-92» and «1895-96» measure 2.9 to 4.2 pt, the length of the hyphens of compound words in the notes (3.4 pt in St.-Pétersbourg, p. 172), and are transcribed as hyphens; only that of «’l–Akhḍarī» is a long dash (4.7 pt).
notes_left L3: «eg.» is printed for heg.
notes_left L12: Nallino's addenda et emendanda (Part I, p. LXXIII) read «205, adn. 1, pro al–Mumti‘ et al–muqni‘ l. al–Mumta‘ et al–maqna‘.»; the printed forms are kept.
notes_right L9-L13: the dashes of «20-23» (3.2 pt) and «al-Battānī» (4.2 pt) are hyphens, that of «Th.–H.» (4.3 pt) a long dash.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
